svg.title: SoundVerse BeatAgent
svg.desc: SoundVerse BeatAgent. A chat agent for three audio jobs: align beats and sync two tracks, edit on a beat grid, and turn short loops into playable web pages. Mechanism: audio goes through Beat This! and a grid fit into a BeatGrid; a typed request goes to Gemini, which returns a plan that a validator checks before it edits the grid. Decision: the LLM only interprets text. On a synthetic 6-minute clip the worst beat error went from 377 ms to 1.92 ms. Limit: all numbers are from synthetic stand-ins, the official test pack was not provided, and sync on real music is unproven. Solo project, 105 commits, no public deployment.
